name: Magnetics
description: Flat (2-D) magnetostatic studies in PartCraft: iron, permanent magnets and coils in an air box, from an example device or your sketches. Flux density, flux lines, force and torque on a body, the result shown on the part and saved as CSV, VTK or SVG. Linear iron unless you give a B–H curve; no 3-D, no eddy currents. An analysis aid, not a design approval.
author: CadCraft
